selection: For each MGRS grid within each query envelope, choose three distinct acquisitions ranked by scene cloud_percent + 0.35*nodata_percent. Scene metadata ranking is not pixel-quality verification. Full 2025 catalog pagination exhausted in each query envelope. Overlapping envelopes can contribute different top-three scenes for the same MGRS grid; global candidate IDs are deduplicated. Targeted exception: eight additional scenes pass native RGB and 7x7 SCL guard at audited object representative points. Their tiny priority windows are scheduling envelopes, not verified coverage polygons.
preview_display: Source TCI RGB visual display is native 10 m; no reflectance scale is applied to TCI. Quantitative RGB bands require DN*scale+offset after nodata mask.
